model_description: Small decoder-only Transformer trained on synthetic raw (a, b, p) -> (a*b mod p) sequences. Receives the raw decimal operands (no deterministic pre-reduction) and learns the full-width reduction and the modular multiplication end-to-end. Digit-level tokenisation, base-10 output.
training_description: Trained from random init on synthetic RAW (a, b, p, a*b mod p) examples with full-width operands sampled at Tier 1-3 scale (operands NOT pre-reduced mod p, matching the raw inference distribution required by the rules); digit-level tokenisation, AdamW, 20k steps.
